deep_documents.title: Raspberry Pi processor documentation (BCM2712 section)
deep_documents.body: The BCM2712 application processor used in Raspberry Pi 5 contains a quad-core Arm Cortex-A76 CPU clocked at 2.4GHz and a VideoCore VII GPU. Unrelated note: the RP1 I/O controller connects to the BCM2712 over PCIe.
